snippet.title: New Game Reveal: "Steel Swarm: Invasion"
snippet.description:
From the creators of Steel Swarm: Apocalypse comes an explosive new chapter in the Steel Swarm universe. Step into the war. Live the invasion.

* High-intensity action RPG – Switch between brutal close-quarters combat and devastating vehicle warfare
* A war-torn world – Explore, uncover hidden truths, and shape history
* Swarm battles & destructible environments – The signature chaos of Steel Swarm is back, bigger than ever
* Deep customization – Build, upgrade, and master your war machine
* A gripping, mature story – Meet iconic characters and make choices that matter

We’re revealing Steel Swarm: Invasion early—and YOU can help shape its development! Wishlist now on Steam and join the growing community.

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3793260
